what_happened: the placement run (rx job 260929-175715-l3h-typed-h1b-4987) computed all 1,998 rows (266.7 s) and stopped at the harness's own identity check 'FLAT positions differ from the v1 record' before writing anything (the tag h1 is still unused; its runner sidecar is results/L3_HOST/runs/_l3d_typed__RUN__metaqa__h1.2.run.json, rc 1)

cause (measured on the laptop, results/L.product: the FLAT dense score Qu[j0:j1] @ Ec.T is a float32 OpenBLAS sgemm; OpenBLAS partitions it by its thread count, so the float sums depend on the number of BLAS threads
cause (measured on the laptop, results/L.laptop: OpenBLAS 0.3.30, Haswell kernel, 12 threads by default (i5-1335U, 12 logical CPUs): every laptop record was computed so
cause (measured on the laptop, results/L.consequence: a host job at another BLAS thread count computes slightly different dense scores, near-tied FLAT ranks flip and the harness refuses the run (as designed)

change.how: rx run --var OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=12 (a thread count, not a credential); the project's [run] defaults are not changed
change.reservation: --cpus 2 --mem 3: the dense sgemm (N 43,234 x 1,536 per 200-row batch) runs on 12 threads for well under a second per batch, everything else on one thread; the job runs BELOW_NORMAL through scratchpad/_l3h_run.py, so normal-priority work (mpr first) keeps the CPU
change.host: DESKTOP-SLQMEQH, i9-14900 (Raptor Lake, 32 logical CPUs, no AVX-512), the same core family as the laptop's i5-1335U, so OpenBLAS's dynamic kernel choice is expected to be Haswell on both; the probe records it
change.gate: the host BLAS probe (python -u scratchpad/_l3h_run.py scratchpad/_l3h_blasprobe.py host_t12, with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=12, through the runner so population rows come from the bundle) must reproduce the laptop inputs (Qu 2d89f7ce5c4e3e83, Ec 95947298bf34822b) and default product sha 5db3e5817cbfc68374a65d3b7c781fd573b74987b8c8ac323573aeea93f0d71e before the placement run is repeated; if the product differs, nothing runs and the kernel is investigated (OPENBLAS_CORETYPE is a further addendum, not a silent change); the placement gate of v1 is unchanged

unchanged: the bundle, the runner, the placement test and its BIT_IDENTICAL gate, the harness pins and every 'never' of the declaration; the placement run repeats with tag h1 (still unused)
